# Vendor Alpha — Data Processing Addendum

## Purpose

This addendum describes how Vendor Alpha handles customer data in
connection with the analytics services described in the accompanying
security report (vendor-alpha-security-report.md).

## Subprocessors

Vendor Alpha uses the following subprocessors for infrastructure and
support functions:

- CloudHost Inc. — primary compute and storage infrastructure
- SupportDesk Ltd. — customer support ticketing

A complete, current subprocessor list is available on request and is
updated within 30 days of any change, consistent with Vendor Alpha's
standard notification practice.

## Data Categories

Vendor Alpha processes the following categories of customer data:
account identifiers, usage event logs, and aggregated behavioral analytics
derived from the above. Vendor Alpha does not process payment card data or
government-issued identifiers.

## Retention

Raw event logs are retained for 90 days and then deleted. Aggregated
analytics are retained for the duration of the customer relationship plus
12 months.

## Security Controls

Data is encrypted at rest and in transit using industry-standard algorithms,
consistent with the certifications described in the accompanying security
report. Access to production data is restricted to authorized personnel
under a documented least-privilege policy.

## Data Subject Requests

Vendor Alpha will support NexusIQ's fulfillment of data subject access,
rectification, and erasure requests within a commercially reasonable
timeframe, coordinated through the support contact in the accompanying
security report.
